description.value:
You quickly shout a mind-bending brainteaser at one creature within 30 feet. That creature must attempt a Will saving throw against your choice of your @Check[will|against:deception]{Deception} or your @Check[will|against:crafting]{Crafting}. Regardless of the result, the creature is then temporarily immune to your Puzzling Outburst for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature figures out your riddle so fast that your ego is bruised. You cannot use Puzzling Outburst for 10 minutes.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is stumped and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} for one minute.

Critical Failure The creature is completely stumped by your riddle and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} for one minute.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
